sentences: I ran for office pledging to restore fiscal responsibility and Congress is embracing it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COAST GUARD AUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: COAST GUARD AUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act provides the Coast Guard a much-needed and historic downpayment of $24 billion for new operational assets and systems.
I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Together with President Trump, we are eliminating billions of dollars of spending, this wasteful spending on leftwing organizations that mock millions of Americans.
We will also eliminate wasteful spending on radical programs in lands far, far away that do not put America first.
I have consistently voted to cut the spigot of spending, and I will continue that record by voting to pass this bill today.
I urge my colleagues to do the same.
